pose_convention: Roblox: position (x, y, z) -> (-x, z, y), so the front is -Z (LookVector). *_angles_roblox_deg
go to CFrame.Angles(math.rad(x), math.rad(y), math.rad(z)); body_cframe_roblox is the
same Body CFrame as CFrame.new(table.unpack(t)), relative to the prop pivot or HumanoidRootPart.
For a cat with `scale` s (Ragdoll, Maine Coon 1.2) multiply every pose position by s.

upright.note: Stands on the hind legs, the base of the bin traps. Working cats sit on body B instead (CatCafe_Cat_<Name>_Sit).

carried.note: Cradled across the chest, facing the character's left, so the camera behind the player sees the cat side on. Relative to the HumanoidRootPart centre (R15: 3 studs above the floor).

lick.note: Sitting, washing a paw: the left front paw up at the mouth, head tipped down to it (Derek 2026-10-27: the paw-up sit is licking a paw).

loaf.note: Lying down, belly on the floor, paws folded under and turned out so they show at the sides.

sleep.note: The loaf with the head down and turned, tail curled round the side.

eat.note: Standing, head down to a bowl in front of the front paws.

work_barista.note: Standing at work, the right paw held out with a takeaway cup (Held_Barista in LegF2).

work_waiter.note: Standing at work, a tray with a cup and a slice of cake held out at the left side (Held_Waiter in LegF1).

work_greeter.note: Standing at work, waving the left paw up and out; nothing held.

work_entertainer.note: Standing at work, a microphone held up under the chin in the right paw (Held_Entertainer in LegF2, leaning in to the mouth), the left paw down at its side.

CatCafe_VFX_ShinySparkle.use: ParticleEmitter.Texture for the ShinySparkle preset; tint with Color

assets.name: CatCafe_Cat_Tabby_Sit
assets.studio: Body B, sitting up: clone this instead of CatCafe_Cat_Tabby for a cat resting in the cafe or working at a station. Put the role's outfit pieces on its Outfit_<Piece> Attachments. Parts with their own joint (Head with the eyes and ears, Tail, LegF1, LegF2) are Models pivoted at the joint, for poses (manifest cat_poses). The Head's Attachment Carry (above the ears) takes a carried tray or coin bag's pivot (F90).

assets.name: CatCafe_Cat_Tabby_Work
assets.studio: Body S, standing at work (Derek 2026-11-02): clone this instead of CatCafe_Cat_Tabby_Sit for a cat working at a station, in the sitting role outfit on its Outfit_<Piece> Attachments. Its front legs are arms (LegF1 the cat's left, LegF2 its right) and LegB1 and LegB2 its legs, each a Model pivoted at its joint, with the Head (eyes and ears inside, Attachment Carry above the ears) and Tail. Each role's held thing is a Model inside an arm, pivoted at the paw: Held_Barista (a cup) and Held_Entertainer (a microphone) in LegF2, Held_Waiter (a tray with a cake) in LegF1; keep the one for the cat's role and remove the others (the greeter holds nothing). Turn the arms with the role's pose (manifest cat_poses work_<role>), which holds the thing upright.

Parts with their own joint (Head with the eyes and ears, Tail, LegF1, LegF2) are Models pivoted at the joint, for poses (manifest cat_poses). assets.name: CatCafe_Cat_Biscuit_Work
